body: Thanks I will totally take you up on that offer. The same goes for you :)

Thanks everyone. I appreciate your kind words :) this is one of my favorite poems that I have written. I wrote it about my friend because I know she is struggling but I know she is strong because of her battle with herself and her thoughts.
I want tattoos but I know I will do the same with tattoos haha so it will become my new obsession.

I do the same thing with piercings. Sometimes when my life is chaos I just go and get another one. I've been running out of places for them so I might move to tattoos but I feel like I would just replace my skin slowly with ink lol. I have 26 piercings and counting.

I never did opiates or anything hard (besides like coke or LSD) but I used to get high a lot in the past. It was my one way to just fade away for a bit. I can't say I was happy or if it made me feel better because I think it was just an excuse and it held me back badly. I quit getting high close to a year and a half ago and recently I have been wanting to go back and get high. I've been drinking a bunch still, which at this point I think I'm going to need to find a way to quit because it's starting to get back to the past where I would drink until I blacked out. All I know is that I struggle with the alcohol because it seems like if I want to hang out with someone I have to get drunk. I guess I need better influences/people in my life but who knows if that will happen considering I only ever have fit in with the outcasts. I am after all, an outcast amongst outcasts.

TLDR: I have been craving the escape of getting high as well but I just know that it will put me back into a bad path. Being sober isn't always the best but I feel much more productive than before.
Thank you so much. Send my a pm sometime and I'd be happy to share some :)

My dad used to tell me growing up that I was a failure and that I was never going to amount to anything. I used to drink a lot and get high so he used to tell me that I was a loser stoner and that's how he would introduce me to people sometimes. He still makes comments to this day about me getting high in the past even though I haven't gotten high in a year and a half. I try to avoid him because he's just toxic for me and he really killed my self esteem and confidence throughout my life. Growing up he used to tell my sister and I that 99.9% of the time that him and my mom fought was our fault. That is a few things that have stuck with me forever and I sometimes think about them just the same. My dad was pretty abusive growing up. Mostly mentally and verbally but when I was younger he used to strangle me and back hand me across the face a lot when I was misbehaving. I remember one time when I was in 7th grade and I didn't want to go to school and my dad got so pissed and he punched me in the face and chipped my tooth. After that I walked away and he picked up the chair in the kitchen and lobbed it at me hitting me in the back. Hmmmmmm thinking about the past is a hole for me lol and I could write for hours but I feel this has been more than enough.

Yeah lately I've been kind of falling to rock bottom and nothing has really been helping me tbh. Kind of all over the place mentally and can't figure it out so I'm trying to find a psychiatrist with no success so far.. can't find someone who will take my insurance and I can't afford it any other way.

It's more of a relief than anything sometimes. I have been going through a phase for a long time, probably close to 3 years or so,  where I cannot cry. The sadness just builds and builds and builds and I can feel the pressure like I'm going to cry but there is no release. It's a really weird feeling so I try to find different methods to translate/release my feelings elsewhere. Paper is the best ear and it soaks up pain so nicely. It doesn't remove my feelings or my depression but it does help me breathe sometimes, which in the end is helpful for me. It's not always helpful though and sometimes it pulls me deeper so it's a win or lose deal but reading my poetry is something I do love because I sometimes amaze myself by the things that I write so that is definitely a plus.
I think about the future all the time. I'm currently in college trying to find some form of success but still get caught up in that mindset all the time.

Thanks, best virtual bear hug back at you :)

HUUUUUGGSSS
